items.summary: Start your morning with Opening Bell, Moneycontrol’s live pre-market show, as we get you ready for today’s trade. With Wall Street ending higher on a tech-led rally, led by SpaceX’s 7% surge on strong earnings and merger prospects with Tesla, we look at what it means for Indian markets. Brent crude is hovering around $110, US yields remain elevated with the 10-year at 5.12%, and traders are watching the Fed meeting on October 28. We also track Gift Nifty for cues on the opening, along with FII and DII activity after Nifty held the 22,800 mark yesterday and the broader markets came under pressure. All eyes are on the Jio IPO, which was fully subscribed within 100 minutes on day one and drew bids worth ₹3.2 lakh crore, making it India’s largest-ever public issue. We also bring you the key stocks in focus on the back of Q2 earnings from Indian Hotels, KEI Industries and M&M Financial Services, and Persistent Systems’ ₹4,265 crore QIP plan. Watch live for expert views, stock ideas and the levels to track as the market gets ready for the opening bell. Like, share and subscribe to Moneycontrol for the latest market updates.

items.summary: Yes Bank faces a potential decline in core equity capital, projected to fall to around 10% due to accumulated coupon payments on AT1 bonds. Crisil Ratings highlighted a significant liability impact estimated at Rs 6,200 crore, while S&P Global Ratings foresees a reduction in common equity by about Rs 8,400 crore. Despite these concerns, both agencies believe the bank's credit profile will remain stable.

HFCL Q2 results: Profit surges to ₹394 crore as AI data centre demand rises
items.summary:
Domestic telecom gear maker HFCL has posted a multi-fold jump in consolidated profit to Rs 394.22 crore in the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, driven by demand for optical fibre cables from AI data centres, the company said in a regulatory filing.
HFCL had posted net profit of around Rs 72 crore in the same period a year ago.
"This is the best-ever quarterly performance in HFCL's history and marks a defining moment in our growth journey. The results reflect the increasing scale, strength and momentum of our business and reinforce our confidence in HFCL's ability to deliver sustained growth and create enduring value for stakeholders," HFCL managing director, Mahendra Nahata, said in a statement.
The company has forecasted 80 per cent revenue growth in the current fiscal over financial year (FY) 2026 and expects to achieve the Rs 10,000 crore revenue mark before projected timeline of FY29.

items.summary: Kross shares jumped nearly 20% after the commercial vehicle components maker reported strong Q2 FY27 results. Revenue rose 79.6% year on year to  ₹235.09 crore, EBITDA increased 107.4% to  ₹30.60 crore, and profit after tax climbed 143.5% to  ₹19.69 crore.

items.title: Kross shares rally 16% after Q2 profit jumps 143% YoY; stock hits 52-week high
items.summary: Kross shares surged following strong Q2 FY27 results, with revenue rising 80% and net profit climbing 143% year-on-year. EBITDA more than doubled, while margins improved. Robust commercial vehicle demand, capacity expansion and operational efficiencies supported growth, alongside increased institutional shareholding and the stock reaching a fresh 52-week high.
